sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取 nytimes.com/subscribe 上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: This week, President Donald Trump made one of the most audacious moves since he took office.
sentences.zh: 本周，唐纳德·特朗普总统采取了他上任以来最大胆的举措之一。

sentences.en: Freezing trillions of dollars in federal money.
sentences.zh: 冻结了数万亿美元的联邦资金。

sentences.en: Everything from anti-poverty programs to foreign aid.
sentences.zh: 从反贫困项目到对外援助，无所不包。

sentences.en: In order to purge the government of what he called woke ideology.
sentences.zh: 目的是为了清除政府中他所称的“觉醒”意识形态。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague White House reporter Mike Scheer on that order.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、白宫记者迈克·希尔将解读这项命令。

sentences.en: The chaos that it prompted.
sentences.zh: 它引发的混乱。

sentences.en: And whether it is likely to survive in court.
sentences.zh: 以及它是否能在法庭上站得住脚。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 今天是星期三。

sentences.en: So Mike, President Trump has done something pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 那么迈克，特朗普总统做了一件相当了不起的事情。

sentences.en: All of Washington, where you are right now, is talking about it.
sentences.zh: 你现在所在的整个华盛顿都在谈论这件事。

sentences.en: And I'm wondering if you can lay out for listeners exactly what he did and what's unfolded in the days since.
sentences.zh: 我想请你为听众梳理一下他到底做了什么，以及随后的几天里发生了什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It really was remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这确实非常了不起。

sentences.en: Essentially, late in the day on Monday, President Trump's budget office, which is called the Office
sentences.zh: 本质上，周一晚些时候，特朗普总统的预算办公室，也就是管理和预算办公室，

sentences.en: of Management and Budget Office of Management and Budget, it reports directly to the president.
sentences.zh: 管理和预算办公室，它直接向总统汇报。

sentences.en: They put out a memo, a really short memo.
sentences.zh: 他们发布了一份备忘录，一份非常简短的备忘录。

sentences.en: It was just two pages.
sentences.zh: 只有两页纸。

sentences.en: But it essentially exploded in Washington the minute it went out.
sentences.zh: 但它在发布的那一刻就在华盛顿引发了爆炸性影响。

sentences.en: Because what it did was it said that every single federal program that involves the delivery
sentences.zh: 因为它要求暂停每一个涉及以拨款或贷款形式向全国任何组织、

sentences.en: of money in the form of a grant or in the form of a loan to any organization, any entity across the country had to be paused.
sentences.zh: 任何实体提供资金的联邦项目。

sentences.en: And I'm just going to read directly from the memo.
sentences.zh: 我直接读一下备忘录的内容。

sentences.en: And it said, the use of federal resources to advance Marxist equity, transgenderism, and
sentences.zh: 它说，利用联邦资源来推进马克思主义公平、跨性别主义和

sentences.en: Green New Deal social engineering policies is a waste of taxpayer dollars that does not improve the day-to-day lives of those we serve.
sentences.zh: “绿色新政”社会工程政策，是对纳税人资金的浪费，并不能改善我们所服务对象的日常生活。

sentences.en: It said that all of the agencies had to pause the funds while they reviewed whether the programs
sentences.zh: 它要求所有机构在审查相关项目（即贷款和拨款）是否

sentences.en: in question, the loans and the grants, were, quote, consistent with the president's policies.
sentences.zh: “符合总统政策”时，必须暂停这些资金。

sentences.en: Okay, so basically the memo is saying all these federal funds go out to all of these programs all over the country.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以基本上备忘录是说，所有这些流向全国各地项目的联邦资金，

sentences.en: They need to be put on hold to make sure that none of them are actually at odds with the administration's agenda.
sentences.zh: 都需要暂停，以确保它们中没有一个与政府的议程相抵触。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is a lot of money, according to the administration's own figures, as much as
sentences.zh: 而且这是一笔巨款，根据政府自己的数据，高达

sentences.en: $3 trillion.
sentences.zh: 3万亿美元。

sentences.en: And the agenda that the memo says these programs must adhere to was really laid out by the president
sentences.zh: 而备忘录中提到的这些项目必须遵守的议程，实际上是由总统在

sentences.en: in a series of executive orders that we've all seen him announce over the course of the eight or nine days that he's been in office.
sentences.zh: 他上任八九天以来宣布的一系列行政命令中提出的。

sentences.en: And we know what those executive orders have tried to do, right?
sentences.zh: 我们都知道这些行政命令试图做什么，对吧？

sentences.en: Root out wokeness in the government, as the president would put it, and really align all of the government's spending with this sort of MAGA agenda that seeks to kind of wipe out
sentences.zh: 用总统的话说，就是根除政府中的“觉醒”文化，并真正使所有政府支出与这种“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）议程保持一致，旨在抹去

sentences.en: some of the efforts that have been made by previous administrations over the past several years.
sentences.zh: 过去几年历届政府所做的一些努力。

sentences.en: So exactly how does the memo propose that this is going to work?
sentences.zh: 那么备忘录具体建议如何实施呢？

sentences.en: What the memo says is that over the course of the next two weeks, starting Tuesday at
sentences.zh: 备忘录说，在接下来的两周内，从周二

sentences.en: 5 p.m., all of these federal agencies are supposed to fill out a spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 下午5点开始，所有这些联邦机构都要填写一份电子表格。

sentences.en: The spreadsheet has every single federal grant and federal loan.
sentences.zh: 表格里列出了每一项联邦拨款和联邦贷款。

sentences.en: And apparently what the Office of Management and Budget will do is essentially go through
sentences.zh: 显然，管理和预算办公室的做法基本上是逐一审查

sentences.en: that spreadsheet if they find programs that don't violate the orders that the president has done.
sentences.zh: 那份表格，如果他们发现项目没有违反总统的命令，

sentences.en: Those will be safe.
sentences.zh: 那些项目就是安全的。

sentences.en: The funding will continue.
sentences.zh: 资金将继续发放。

sentences.en: But that in some fashion, if they identify the programs that they think are funding things that President Trump would not want to fund or are blocked by these executive orders,
sentences.zh: 但如果他们以某种方式认定这些项目资助了特朗普总统不想资助的内容，或者被这些行政命令所禁止，

sentences.en: that funding would be then at risk.
sentences.zh: 那么这些资金就会面临风险。

sentences.en: So which programs exactly will be affected here?
sentences.zh: 那么具体哪些项目会受到影响呢？

sentences.en: What do we know about that?
sentences.zh: 我们对此了解多少？

sentences.en: Well, the memo is quite broad, and it's clear that it is intended to cover the vast sweep of most government prograMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这份备忘录范围很广，很明显它旨在覆盖大多数政府项目。

sentences.en: There's literally hundreds and hundreds of grant programs and federal loan programs that provide
sentences.zh: 实际上有成百上千个拨款项目和联邦贷款项目，为

sentences.en: money to organizations, nonprofits, state agencies, state programs, local programs across the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的组织、非营利机构、州政府机构、州项目和地方项目提供资金。

sentences.en: Just to give you a sense of how far-ranging this could be, it's everything from Head Start programs for
sentences.zh: 为了让你了解其影响范围有多广，它涵盖了从幼儿教育的“启智计划”（Head Start），

sentences.en: early childhood education, grants that cover renewable energy research and clean energy demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 到涵盖可再生能源研究和清洁能源示范的拨款。

sentences.en: There are special education grants.
sentences.zh: 还有特殊教育拨款。

sentences.en: All of those would have to be subject to this order.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都必须遵守这项命令。

sentences.en: There are some exceptions.
sentences.zh: 也有一些例外。

sentences.en: One exception, for example, says that nothing in this memo should be construed to impact
sentences.zh: 例如，其中一个例外规定，本备忘录中的任何内容均不得被解释为影响

sentences.en: Medicare or Social Security benefits.
sentences.zh: 医疗保险（Medicare）或社会保障福利。

sentences.en: They go on to explain that it's any type of assistance that's directly received by individuals wouldn't be affected.
sentences.zh: 他们进一步解释说，任何个人直接收到的援助都不会受到影响。

sentences.en: So that leaves this sort of vast other area where the money is provided not directly to people, but to organizations or states or other programs that provide benefits to Americans,
sentences.zh: 所以这就留下了另一个广阔的领域，即资金不是直接提供给个人，而是提供给组织、州或其他为美国人提供福利的项目，

sentences.en: but not in a direct way.
sentences.zh: 但不是以直接的方式。

sentences.en: Okay, so this memo, as you say, is quite a bombshell in Washington.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以正如你所说，这份备忘录在华盛顿引起了轩然大波。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, what happens next is kind of a freakout, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，接下来发生的事情简直是一场恐慌，对吧？

sentences.en: Across the country, people begin to wonder what impact this is going to have.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的人们开始担心这会产生什么影响。

sentences.en: Who's on the list?
sentences.zh: 谁在名单上？

sentences.en: That's the big question that's sort of ricocheting across Washington, but also across the country in all of these programs that rely on the federal government for money.
sentences.zh: 这是在华盛顿乃至全国所有依赖联邦政府资金的项目中回荡的重大问题。

sentences.en: They wake up and are trying to figure out, is my program affected?
sentences.zh: 他们醒来后都在试图弄清楚：我的项目受影响了吗？

sentences.en: You know, if so, how do I deal with that?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果是的话，我该怎么处理？

sentences.en: And so by midday Tuesday, after all of the angst in the country, the White House decides it needs to respond.
sentences.zh: 因此，到了周二中午，在全国一片焦虑之后，白宫决定必须做出回应。

sentences.en: Good to see all of you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到大家。

sentences.en: Carolyn Levitt, who is the new White House press secretary for Mr. Trump, has her first press briefing for the White House press corps, and she really tries to push back.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生的新任白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特举行了她对白宫记者团的首次新闻发布会，她确实试图进行反击。

sentences.en: Well, I think there's only uncertainty in this room amongst the media.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这个房间里的媒体只有不确定性。

sentences.en: There's no uncertainty in this building.
sentences.zh: 这栋大楼里没有不确定性。

sentences.en: So let me provide the certainty and the clarity that all of you need.
sentences.zh: 所以让我来提供你们所有人所需要的确定性和清晰度。

sentences.en: You know, she really tries to explain that, no, there's a lot of these programs that are not going to be affected.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她确实试图解释说，不，这些项目中有很多是不会受到影响的。

sentences.en: Social security benefits, Medicare benefits, food stamps, welfare benefits, assistance that is going directly to individuals will not be impacted by this pause.
sentences.zh: 社会保障福利、医疗保险福利、食品券、福利救济金，这些直接发给个人的援助不会受到此次暂停的影响。

sentences.en: It's essentially the White House trying to kind of reassure its own people that this big dramatic action by the president isn't going to sort of hit them in the pocketbooks
sentences.zh: 这基本上是白宫试图安抚自己的人，让他们相信总统的这一重大戏剧性行动不会直接

sentences.en: directly.
sentences.zh: 触及他们的钱包。

sentences.en: But the questions keep piling up.
sentences.zh: 但问题还在不断堆积。

sentences.en: How long is this pause going to last?
sentences.zh: 这次暂停会持续多久？

sentences.en: Do you think there will be a list of who is affected and how much money is affected?
sentences.zh: 你认为会有一份受影响者和受影响金额的名单吗？

sentences.en: Medicaid.
sentences.zh: 医疗补助计划（Medicaid）。

sentences.en: Is that affected?
sentences.zh: 那个受影响吗？

sentences.en: What about Medicaid, the health insurance program for low-income people?
sentences.zh: 医疗补助计划，那个为低收入人群提供的健康保险项目呢？

sentences.en: That's funded through money sent to the states by the federal government.
sentences.zh: 那是通过联邦政府拨给各州的资金来资助的。

sentences.en: Are you guaranteeing here that no individual now on Medicaid would see a cutoff because of the pause?
sentences.zh: 你在这里保证现在医疗补助计划上的个人不会因为这次暂停而中断服务吗？

sentences.en: I'll check back on that and get back to you.
sentences.zh: 我会核实一下，然后再回复你。

sentences.en: John.
sentences.zh: 约翰。

sentences.en: The White House later says that Medicaid is not impacted by the memo.
sentences.zh: 白宫后来表示，医疗补助计划不受该备忘录影响。

sentences.en: But the problem is that the reality is actually happening more quickly than their statements can keep up with.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，现实情况的发展速度实际上比他们的声明要快得多。

sentences.en: So you have the system by which state Medicaid offices log in to get their money from the
sentences.zh: 所以，州医疗补助办公室登录以从联邦政府获取资金的系统

sentences.en: federal government not only goes down, so all these states are locked out, but it goes down with a big red banner across the top that says the system is down and we're delaying or
sentences.zh: 不仅瘫痪了，导致所有这些州都被拒之门外，而且系统顶部还出现了一个巨大的红色横幅，写着系统已关闭，我们正在根据总统的行政命令延迟或

sentences.en: canceling payments based on the president's executive orders.
sentences.zh: 取消付款。

sentences.en: So it becomes very clear very quickly that this memo has actually begun to have real-world implications.
sentences.zh: 所以很快就很清楚，这份备忘录实际上已经开始产生现实世界的影响了。

sentences.en: It makes sense of that disconnect.
sentences.zh: 这解释了那种脱节。

sentences.en: I mean, the White House is saying Medicaid not affected, but Medicaid clearly was affected.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，白宫说医疗补助计划不受影响，但它显然受到了影响。

sentences.en: I mean, was the White House just not being forthcoming?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，白宫只是没有如实相告吗？

sentences.en: I'm not sure we know 100 percent the answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 我不确定我们是否百分之百知道这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: I mean, in some ways, it's kind of a feature, not a bug, of the Trump presidency is that he embraces the chaos.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某种程度上，特朗普总统任期的特点而非缺陷就是他拥抱混乱。

sentences.en: He likes the sense that the American people feel like he's just out there, you know, fighting for them.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢那种让美国人民觉得他就在外面为他们而战的感觉。

sentences.en: And like a wrecking ball, essentially, right?
sentences.zh: 就像一个破坏球，基本上是这样，对吧？

sentences.en: Like from President Trump's perspective, from the perspective of his supporters, they want him to come in like a bull in a China shop and kind of disrupt everything.
sentences.zh: 从特朗普总统的角度来看，从他支持者的角度来看，他们希望他像闯进瓷器店的公牛一样进来，颠覆一切。

sentences.en: And so I think in some ways, the Trump administration isn't so concerned about not having the answers to all the questions.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在某种程度上，特朗普政府并不太担心无法回答所有问题。

sentences.en: But I think that one of the repercussions of that is for the rest of the country, and especially in this case, the vast numbers of organizations that rely upon this funding
sentences.zh: 但我认为其后果之一是对于全国其他地区，特别是在这种情况下，对于大量依赖这种资金的组织来说，

sentences.en: and they need the money to pay rent, to pay salaries, to pay out benefits to people.
sentences.zh: 他们需要这笔钱来支付租金、支付工资、向人们发放福利。

sentences.en: All of that has to happen in an organized and methodical way.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都必须以有组织和有条理的方式进行。

sentences.en: And this is anything but.
sentences.zh: 而这完全不是那样。

sentences.en: But to that point, what are those thousands upon thousands of organizations and grantees saying?
sentences.zh: 但说到这一点，那成千上万的组织和受赠方在说什么？

sentences.en: What's happening over the course of the day?
sentences.zh: 这一天里发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's been a mixed bag.
sentences.zh: 嗯，情况好坏参半。

sentences.en: And, you know, our reporters have sort of reached out broadly across the spectrum.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们的记者已经在各个领域进行了广泛的接触。

sentences.en: And some of them have not seen any direct impact yet, but they're essentially wringing their hands, right?
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人还没有看到任何直接影响，但他们基本上都在忧心忡忡，对吧？

sentences.en: They're worried that maybe their research grant is funded by the federal government and they're not sure whether that will continue.
sentences.zh: 他们担心他们的研究经费是否由联邦政府资助，他们不确定这是否会继续。

sentences.en: Or perhaps they have a program that provides benefits to migrants and they're not sure if that's going to pass muster.
sentences.zh: 或者也许他们有一个为移民提供福利的项目，他们不确定这是否能通过审查。

sentences.en: So there has been a lot of hand wringing.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多焦虑不安。

sentences.en: And then there have been some examples of actual impact.
sentences.zh: 然后也有一些实际影响的例子。

sentences.en: One of my colleagues talked to a woman who runs Head Start programs in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 我的一位同事采访了一位在密歇根州经营“启智计划”的女士。

sentences.en: She has something like 41 schools that have about 600 students that come every day.
sentences.zh: 她有大约41所学校，每天有大约600名学生来上课。

sentences.en: When all of this started going down on Tuesday, she decided to cancel class for Wednesday, essentially
sentences.zh: 当周二这一切开始发生时，她决定取消周三的课程，基本上是

sentences.en: worried that if funding dried up from the federal government, it was unclear whether she could continue.
sentences.zh: 担心如果联邦政府的资金枯竭，她不确定是否能继续经营。

sentences.en: And so there have been those kinds of examples where people have actually taken steps to stop what they're doing out of fear that continuing could sort of violate these executive
sentences.zh: 所以确实有这样的例子，人们因为担心继续下去可能会违反这些行政命令或特朗普总统想要做的事情，而实际上采取了停止工作的措施。

sentences.en: orders or what President Trump wants to do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it sounds like mass confusion is at least the bare minimum of what was happening.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来大规模的混乱至少是当时发生的最低限度的情况。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Chaos, confusion across the country.
sentences.zh: 全国范围内的混乱和困惑。

sentences.en: But at the same time, another thing is happening.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，另一件事也在发生。

sentences.en: A real effort to try to stop this whole thing from moving forward, both politically and legally.
sentences.zh: 在政治和法律上，都在努力阻止这一切继续推进。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都会制作《拼字蜜蜂》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Mike, tell us about the fights that have been brewing over this order since it was issued.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，告诉我们自这项命令发布以来，围绕它引发的争论吧。

sentences.en: So, the first fight that immediately happened was the political one.
sentences.zh: 首先，最直接引发的就是政治上的争论。

sentences.en: The scope of the damage that will be done is enormous.
sentences.zh: 它将造成的损害范围是巨大的。

sentences.en: The Democrats on Capitol Hill immediately seized on this.
sentences.zh: 国会山的民主党人立即抓住了这一点。

sentences.en: So, as we stand here today, people should think about the mom who doesn't know if she can get her kid to childcare today.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们今天站在这里时，人们应该想想那位不知道今天能否把孩子送到托儿所的母亲。

sentences.en: This is a dagger at the heart of the average American family in red states, in blue states, in cities, in suburbs, in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 这对红州、蓝州、城市、郊区和农村地区的普通美国家庭来说，简直是当头一棒。

sentences.en: It is just outrageous.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人愤慨。

sentences.en: Asserting in a really forceful way that what the president had done would affect Americans, would hurt Americans.
sentences.zh: 他们以一种非常有力的姿态断言，总统所做的事情会影响美国人，会伤害美国人。

sentences.en: This decision is lawless, dangerous, destructive, cruel.
sentences.zh: 这项决定是无法无天的、危险的、破坏性的、残忍的。

sentences.en: It's illegal.
sentences.zh: 这是非法的。

sentences.en: It's unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 这是违宪的。

sentences.en: The idea on the part of the Democrats was that not only would this have a really terrible impact on people who rely on this federal money,
sentences.zh: 民主党人的想法是，这不仅会对依赖这笔联邦资金的人产生非常可怕的影响，

sentences.en: but they also questioned whether it would even be constitutional.
sentences.zh: 而且他们还质疑这是否符合宪法。

sentences.en: I spoke to my attorney general this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上和我的总检察长谈过了。

sentences.en: She's head of the State Attorneys General Association.
sentences.zh: 她是州总检察长协会的负责人。

sentences.en: They're going to court right away on this horror.
sentences.zh: 他们正准备就这场灾难立即诉诸法庭。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 而在周二，

sentences.en: you had many Democratic state attorneys general coming together to file a lawsuit to try to block the president's order from going into effect and keep the money flowing.
sentences.zh: 许多民主党州总检察长联合起来提起诉讼，试图阻止总统的命令生效，并保持资金流动。

sentences.en: You had progressive groups who filed separate lawsuits trying to do the same.
sentences.zh: 还有一些进步派团体提起了单独的诉讼，试图做同样的事情。

sentences.en: The goal for all of them to try to block President Trump from moving forward with his actions regarding all of this federal money.
sentences.zh: 他们的共同目标是试图阻止特朗普总统在所有这些联邦资金问题上推进他的行动。

sentences.en: OK, so you did have these legal challenges coming out pretty much right away.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以确实几乎立即就出现了这些法律挑战。

sentences.en: What were they arguing exactly?
sentences.zh: 他们到底在争论什么？

sentences.en: Well, essentially,
sentences.zh: 嗯，本质上，

sentences.en: the gist from all of the different lawsuits boiled down to a general argument that what the president had done with this memo essentially violates the heart of the Constitution,
sentences.zh: 所有不同诉讼的核心归结为一个普遍的论点，即总统用这份备忘录所做的事情本质上违反了宪法的核心，

sentences.en: which gives Congress the power of the purse.
sentences.zh: 即赋予国会“钱袋子”权力。

sentences.en: It says Congress has the ability to decide how much money is spent, where is that money is spent.
sentences.zh: 宪法规定国会有权决定花多少钱，以及钱花在哪里。

sentences.en: And that, you know, essentially the executive, in this case, President Trump and his administration,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，本质上行政部门，在本案中是特朗普总统及其政府，

sentences.en: is required and that the language in the Constitution is to faithfully execute the laws that are passed, right?
sentences.zh: 被要求——宪法中的措辞是——忠实地执行通过的法律，对吧？

sentences.en: And that by essentially holding back this money, President Trump was violating that basic precept of constitutional law.
sentences.zh: 而通过扣留这笔资金，特朗普总统违反了宪法法律的这一基本准则。

sentences.en: So in other words, the argument is Trump and the executive branch can't just suddenly take on a power that's always belonged to Congress.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们的论点是特朗普和行政部门不能突然承担一直属于国会的权力。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then another argument actually goes to a much more specific law, and that was the Impoundment Act of 1974.
sentences.zh: 另一个论点实际上指向了一项更具体的法律，即1974年的《扣留资金法》。

sentences.en: OK, we're going to have to define that for people.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们得为听众解释一下这个。

sentences.en: I do not know what that is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was essentially part of the reform efforts after President Nixon had really pursued aggressively a kind of imperial presidency in which he would pick and choose the laws and the spending that he wanted to put into action after Congress had passed them.
sentences.zh: 这本质上是尼克松总统在积极追求一种“帝国总统制”之后改革努力的一部分，在这种制度下，他会在国会通过法律后，挑选他想要执行的法律和支出。

sentences.en: That essentially provided the impetus for Congress to reassert its authority and say, no, no, no,
sentences.zh: 这本质上为国会重申其权威提供了动力，并说，不，不，不，

sentences.en: if you had any doubt that the Constitution actually mandates that the executive branch must put into effect the laws that we passed,
sentences.zh: 如果你对宪法实际上要求行政部门必须执行我们通过的法律有任何怀疑，

sentences.en: we're going to pass a law that actually says that and makes that very clear.
sentences.zh: 我们将通过一项法律，明确规定这一点，并使其非常清晰。

sentences.en: And, Mike, what does the Trump administration say to these kinds of arguments that what he's doing here is illegal?
sentences.zh: 迈克，特朗普政府对这些关于他所做的是非法的论点有什么回应？

sentences.en: Essentially, they waved them aside.
sentences.zh: 本质上，他们把这些论点挥手撇开了。

sentences.en: Carolyn Levitt, the press secretary, in her press briefing, essentially said, we disagree.
sentences.zh: 新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特在新闻发布会上基本上说，我们不同意。

sentences.en: Our lawyers think that what the president has done is perfectly legal.
sentences.zh: 我们的律师认为总统所做的是完全合法的。

sentences.en: And part of their argument relies, I think, on the temporary nature of the pause.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们的部分论点依赖于这种暂停的临时性质。

sentences.en: And, you know, whether they're right or the other folks are right, obviously, is up for argument, will be argued in courts.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们是对的还是其他人是对的，显然是有争议的，将在法庭上进行辩论。

sentences.en: But essentially, the White House position was we don't put any stock in the legal arguments against this.
sentences.zh: 但本质上，白宫的立场是我们不看重针对此事的法律论点。

sentences.en: We're very confident.
sentences.zh: 我们非常有信心。

sentences.en: And to underscore that point, Carolyn Levitt said at the briefing today that the White House fully intends to defend what the president did all the way to the Supreme Court,
sentences.zh: 为了强调这一点，卡罗琳·莱维特在今天的发布会上表示，白宫完全打算捍卫总统所做的一切，如果有必要，一直打到最高法院。

sentences.en: if necessary.
sentences.zh: 如果有必要的话。

sentences.en: So, Mike, we are talking at about 6.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，我们现在是周二下午6点30分左右在交谈，

sentences.en: on Tuesday, and we already have some updates on these lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 我们已经收到了一些关于这些诉讼的最新消息。

sentences.en: Tell us how the lawsuits have started to make their way through the legal system.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们这些诉讼是如何开始在法律体系中推进的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we're really at the very, very beginning.
sentences.zh: 我们真的还处于非常、非常早期的阶段。

sentences.en: But late Tuesday, a judge in the District of Columbia did rule, at least temporarily, on one of the cases brought by a progressive group,
sentences.zh: 但在周二晚些时候，哥伦比亚特区的一位法官确实对进步派团体提起的其中一起案件做出了裁决，至少是暂时性的，

sentences.en: essentially putting a temporary stay on the president's order.
sentences.zh: 本质上是对总统的命令下达了临时限制令。

sentences.en: That means that the White House, the administration, is unable to move forward in enforcing the order.
sentences.zh: 这意味着白宫，即政府，无法继续执行该命令。

sentences.en: The judge said that she would rule in a more permanent way on February 3rd.
sentences.zh: 法官表示，她将在2月3日做出更永久性的裁决。

sentences.en: So essentially, for a number of days, the president's effort here is at least temporarily blocked.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，在接下来的几天里，总统的这项努力至少暂时被阻止了。

sentences.en: So does that mean a full pause on this entire effort?
sentences.zh: 那这是否意味着整个努力完全暂停了？

sentences.en: It does, at least for the moment.
sentences.zh: 是的，至少目前是这样。

sentences.en: And you said they already mentioned that they were ready for this to go all the way up to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 你说他们已经提到他们准备好让这件事一直打到最高法院了。

sentences.en: Might it go that far?
sentences.zh: 它可能会走到那一步吗？

sentences.en: And what do you think will happen if it does?
sentences.zh: 你认为如果真的走到那一步会发生什么？

sentences.en: So this feels like one of those moments in Washington where there is a real fundamental issue at stake, right?
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是华盛顿那种真正存在根本性问题的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: The question of the power of an executive to make a sweeping decision like this versus the power of Congress to essentially control and mandate that their laws are faithfully executed.
sentences.zh: 行政部门做出这种全面决定的权力，与国会本质上控制并要求其法律得到忠实执行的权力之间的较量。

sentences.en: In those moments when there are real clashes between executive and legislative power tends to be where the federal court system really does engage.
sentences.zh: 在行政权和立法权发生真正冲突的时刻，往往是联邦法院系统真正介入的时候。

sentences.en: And they do engage typically in a quick way.
sentences.zh: 而且他们通常会迅速介入。

sentences.en: So it's hard to predict 100% what will happen and how this will play out.
sentences.zh: 所以很难百分之百预测会发生什么以及事态将如何发展。

sentences.en: But I think most people we've talked to believe that this will make its way pretty quickly to the Supreme Court and that the Supreme Court justices will likely take it up because it is in their interest to clarify and to rule on,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们交谈过的大多数人都相信，这件事会很快传到最高法院，而且最高法院大法官很可能会受理，因为澄清并裁决一个相当根本的总统权力问题符合他们的利益，

sentences.en: you know, a pretty fundamental question of presidential power.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: And do we have a sense of how the Supreme Court might rule?
sentences.zh: 我们是否了解最高法院可能会如何裁决？

sentences.en: Well, it's always hard to know, but I did talk to our colleague, Adam Liptak, who is our exceptional Supreme Court reporter.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这总是很难说，但我确实和我们的同事亚当·利普塔克谈过，他是我们杰出的最高法院记者。

sentences.en: Adam is always cautious not to make too many predictions,
sentences.zh: 亚当总是很谨慎，不做太多的预测，

sentences.en: but I think that he generally thinks that the presidents probably favor Congress in this fight and that the clarity with which Congress over the years has described that power probably means that the courts will rule against the president.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他总体上认为总统在这场斗争中可能偏向国会，而且国会多年来描述该权力的清晰度可能意味着法院将做出不利于总统的裁决。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's to be seen.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这还有待观察。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess it raises the question, though, you know, if the memo isn't really likely to survive a court challenge ultimately, if it goes away in a matter of days or weeks,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想这引出了一个问题，如果这份备忘录最终不太可能在法律挑战中幸存，如果它在几天或几周内就消失了，

sentences.en: the Trump administration presumably would have seen that coming.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府大概早就预料到了这一点。

sentences.en: So what was the point of all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么这一切的意义何在？

sentences.en: What were they actually up to?
sentences.zh: 他们到底在搞什么？

sentences.en: Well, so I think that, you know, they are serious about pushing through changes to federal law when they can.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我认为，你知道，他们是认真地想要在可能的情况下推动联邦法律的变革。

sentences.en: You know, I don't think they would have embarked on this effort if they thought that it was not possible that they could win.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不认为如果他们认为自己不可能获胜，他们就会开始这项努力。

sentences.en: But they also recognize that if they don't ultimately win on a kind of legal basis and this memo either has to be scaled back or changed or maybe it never gets implemented at all.
sentences.zh: 但他们也认识到，如果他们最终不能在法律基础上获胜，而这份备忘录要么必须缩减、修改，要么可能根本无法实施。

sentences.en: I think from their perspective, they still have sent a really strong message to the country, to especially President Trump's most ardent supporters, that he is trying, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为从他们的角度来看，他们仍然向全国，特别是向特朗普总统最热情的支持者传达了一个非常强烈的信号，那就是他在努力，对吧？

sentences.en: That he isn't somebody who's going to come in and tinker around the edges, that he really wants to fundamentally change the country.
sentences.zh: 他不是那种只会修修补补的人，他真的想从根本上改变这个国家。

sentences.en: And that message, that political message, is almost as important as succeeding in the end for them.
sentences.zh: 而那个信息，那个政治信息，对他们来说几乎和最终成功一样重要。

sentences.en: You know, he won't win all the time, and I think they know that, but that is sort of besides the point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他不会一直赢，我想他们知道这一点，但这有点偏离重点了。

sentences.en: Mike, as we prepared for a potential second Trump administration, reporting really suggested that Trump 2.0 was going to be very different than Trump 1.0.
sentences.zh: 迈克，在我们为潜在的第二个特朗普政府做准备时，报道确实表明“特朗普2.0”将与“特朗普1.0”非常不同。

sentences.en: It would be more organized.
sentences.zh: 它会更有组织性。

sentences.en: It would be more effective.
sentences.zh: 它会更有效率。

sentences.en: You know, Trump knows how the government works now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普现在知道政府是如何运作的了。

sentences.en: He has lawyers who have executive orders written ready to go.
sentences.zh: 他有律师准备好了行政命令，随时可以发布。

sentences.en: But this memo today and the chaos it sparked would seem to kind of undercut that idea.
sentences.zh: 但今天的这份备忘录以及它引发的混乱似乎削弱了这种想法。

sentences.en: So how do you make sense of that?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何理解这一点？

sentences.en: You know, it's actually – I was thinking about this today.
sentences.zh: 你知道，实际上——我今天一直在想这个问题。

sentences.en: Today was the first time that it really felt like the first Trump term, which I covered from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 今天是我第一次真正感觉到像我从一开始就报道的第一个特朗普任期。

sentences.en: I recalled covering the White House, the first Trump White House, at the end of the first week when President Trump signed the travel ban on several majority Muslim countries.
sentences.zh: 我记得在第一周结束时报道白宫，第一个特朗普白宫，当时特朗普总统签署了针对几个穆斯林占多数国家的旅行禁令。

sentences.en: The chaos there was very similar in the sense that people didn't understand what was happening.
sentences.zh: 那里的混乱非常相似，因为人们不明白发生了什么。

sentences.en: I remember talking to Trump administration officials late into the night, asking them for details about what the executive order meant, how it would be implemented.
sentences.zh: 我记得深夜与特朗普政府官员交谈，询问他们关于行政命令意味着什么、将如何实施的细节。

sentences.en: They didn't have any of the answers.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何答案。

sentences.en: But I think what's a bit different here from the chaos of the first Trump term is that now Trump has a bit more of an intention, you know,
sentences.zh: 但我认为这里与第一个特朗普任期的混乱有点不同的是，现在特朗普有了更多的意图，你知道，

sentences.en: not only to have kind of political power and to, you know, have a presidency for another four years,
sentences.zh: 不仅是为了拥有某种政治权力，为了再当四年总统，

sentences.en: but it's to reshape this whole government that he sees as having been filled with woke ideology and liberal ideology and to purge it of all of that and remake it in his image,
sentences.zh: 而是为了重塑整个政府，他认为政府里充满了“觉醒”意识形态和自由派意识形态，要清除所有这些，并按照他的形象重塑它，

sentences.en: in the, you know, make America great movement ideology.
sentences.zh: 按照“让美国再次伟大”运动的意识形态。

sentences.en: That's, you know, for him, President Trump is all about making sure that he leaves a legacy that the country has been, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是，你知道，对他来说，特朗普总统所做的一切都是为了确保他留下一个遗产，即这个国家，

sentences.en: and certainly the government has been remade in his image.
sentences.zh: 当然还有政府，已经按照他的形象进行了重塑。

sentences.en: And the question is, will the institutions hold?
sentences.zh: 问题是，这些机构能坚持住吗？

sentences.en: It's always the question, right?
sentences.zh: 这永远是个问题，对吧？

sentences.en: The question was asked the first time around during the first four years.
sentences.zh: 第一次任期那四年里也问过这个问题。

sentences.en: And I think what we see in what's happened over the last eight or nine days and especially what's happened from Monday night forward is that President Trump is absolutely willing and determined to test the boundaries,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在过去八九天发生的事情，特别是从周一晚上开始发生的事情中看到的是，特朗普总统绝对愿意并决心测试边界，

sentences.en: to test the institutions of government and see how far he can get in his efforts to remake the government in his image.
sentences.zh: 测试政府机构，看看他在按照自己的形象重塑政府的努力中能走多远。

sentences.en: And he will continue to push and the institutions will continue to push back.
sentences.zh: 他将继续推动，而机构将继续反击。

sentences.en: And I think the American people will be watching the outcome of that for the days, weeks, months and probably years to come.
sentences.zh: 我认为美国人民将在未来几天、几周、几个月甚至几年里关注这一结果。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Happy to.
sentences.zh: 乐意效劳。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: President Trump moved toward pushing transgender people out of the military by telling the Pentagon that anyone who openly identified that way
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统通过告诉五角大楼，任何公开认同跨性别身份的人，

sentences.en: should be seen as having an impediment to the physical and mental well-being necessary for military service.
sentences.zh: 都应被视为在军事服役所需的身体和心理健康方面存在障碍，从而推动将跨性别者赶出军队。

sentences.en: While the order did not immediately exclude anyone from the military, it gave the Pentagon 60 days to update its policy on medical standards
sentences.zh: 虽然该命令没有立即将任何人排除在军队之外，但它给了五角大楼60天的时间来更新其医疗标准政策，

sentences.en: and 30 days to come forward with revised guidance on how to implement Trump's vision.
sentences.zh: 并有30天的时间提出关于如何实施特朗普愿景的修订指南。

sentences.en: And also on Tuesday, the Trump administration offered roughly 2 million federal workers the option to resign and still be paid through the end of September.
sentences.zh: 同样在周二，特朗普政府向大约200万联邦工作人员提供了辞职的选择，并仍可获得工资直到9月底。

sentences.en: The message came in the form of an email from the Office of Personnel Management, which oversees the federal workforce.
sentences.zh: 该信息以电子邮件的形式发送，来自负责监督联邦劳动力的联邦人事管理局。

sentences.en: It had the subject line, fork in the road, and said that a majority of federal agencies would probably be downsized
sentences.zh: 邮件主题是“十字路口”，并称大多数联邦机构可能会被缩减，

sentences.en: and that a substantial number of employees would be furloughed or reclassified to a status that would make them easier to fire.
sentences.zh: 并且相当数量的员工将被停薪留职或重新分类到一种更容易被解雇的状态。

sentences.en: The effort was meant to reduce the size of the federal workforce and to help push out people who do not support President Trump's political agenda.
sentences.zh: 此举旨在减少联邦劳动力的规模，并帮助排挤那些不支持特朗普总统政治议程的人。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko and Will Reed, with help from Sidney Harper, Carlos Prieto, and Michael Simon Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科和威尔·里德制作，西德尼·哈珀、卡洛斯·普列托和迈克尔·西蒙·约翰逊提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.戴维斯·林恩编辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛萨诺的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Davis Lynn, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹维克创作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争的控制之中。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格一起，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
